chinese: 康樂及文化事務署（康文署）將舉辦先進運動會2025／26，鼓勵35歲或以上的市民與年齡相若的對手切磋技術，從中享受運動的樂趣。
english: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department (LCSD) will hold the Masters Games 2025/26 to encourage members of the public aged 35 or above to join competitions with peers and enjoy the fun of sports.

chinese: 康樂及文化事務署（康文署）將舉辦先進運動會2025／26，鼓勵35歲或以上的市民與年齡相若的對手切磋技術，從中享受運動的樂趣。
english: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department (LCSD) will hold the Masters Games 2025/26 to encourage members of the public aged 35 or below to join competitions with peers and enjoy the fun of sports.

chinese: 各項比賽十月中起分階段接受報名。
english: Enrolment for different events will open from mid-October in stages.

chinese: 各項比賽十月中起分階段接受報名。
english: Enrolment for different events will open from mid-November in stages.

chinese: 兩年一度的先進運動會將於明年一月至六月舉行，設有羽毛球、長跑、游泳、乒乓球、網球和太極共六個比賽項目。
english: Held biennially, the upcoming Masters Games will be held from January to June next year. A total of six competition events will include badminton, distance run, swimming, table tennis, tennis and Tai Chi.

chinese: 兩年一度的先進運動會將於明年一月至六月舉行，設有羽毛球、長跑、游泳、乒乓球、網球和太極共六個比賽項目。
english: Held biennially, the upcoming Masters Games will be held from January to June next year. A total of eight competition events will include badminton, distance run, swimming, table tennis, tennis and Tai Chi.

chinese: 有意參加的巿民可透過SmartPLAY康體通遞交電子抽籤申請。
english: Interested persons should make e-applications for balloting through SmartPLAY.

chinese: 如抽籤後仍有餘額，巿民可於各比賽項目的公開報名階段重新報名，名額先到先得。
english: Any remaining quotas after balloting will be released for fresh applications in the open enrolment period on a first-come, first-served basis.

chinese: 如抽籤後仍有餘額，巿民可於各比賽項目的公開報名階段重新報名，名額先到先得。
english: Any remaining quotas after balloting will not be released for fresh applications in the open enrolment period.

chinese: 個人賽和隊際賽報名費用分別為20元和60元。
english: The enrolment fees for individual and team events are $20 and $60 respectively.

chinese: 個人賽和隊際賽報名費用分別為20元和60元。
english: The enrolment fees for individual and team events are $60 and $20 respectively.

chinese: 合資格的60歲或以上人士、全日制學生或殘疾人士報名個人賽可獲半費優惠。
english: Participants aged 60 or above, full-time students or persons with disabilities are eligible for a 50 per cent concessionary rate.

chinese: 合資格的60歲或以上人士、全日制學生或殘疾人士報名個人賽可獲半費優惠。
english: Participants aged 65 or above, full-time students or persons with disabilities are eligible for a 50 per cent concessionary rate.

chinese: 如有查詢，可致電2601 7673。
english: For enquiries, please call 2601 7673.

chinese: 歡迎有志於當代藝術領域發展的人士申請。
english: Persons who desire to pursue work in the contemporary art field are welcome to apply.

chinese: 歡迎有志於當代藝術領域發展的人士申請。
english: Only persons with work experience in the contemporary art field may apply.

chinese: 截止日期為一月三十日。
english: The deadline for applications is January 30.

chinese: 截止日期為一月三十日。
english: The deadline for applications is January 13.

chinese: 「威尼斯視藝雙年展實習計劃2026」將設六個名額，獲選實習生將接受香藝術館提供的專業培訓，在威尼斯駐留實習六個星期，親身參與這個全球歷史最悠久的國際當代藝術盛事。
english: Six interns will be engaged in the Venice Biennale Internship Programme 2026. Selected candidates will receive professional training provided by the HKMoA and join a six-week on-site internship programme in Venice, participating in the world's oldest international exhibition of contemporary visual arts.

chinese: 「威尼斯視藝雙年展實習計劃2026」將設六個名額，獲選實習生將接受香藝術館提供的專業培訓，在威尼斯駐留實習六個星期，親身參與這個全球歷史最悠久的國際當代藝術盛事。
english: Six interns will be engaged in the Venice Biennale Internship Programme 2026. Selected candidates will receive professional training provided by the HKMoA and join a six-month on-site internship programme in Venice, participating in the world's oldest international exhibition of contemporary visual arts.

chinese: 實習生將協助香港展的籌備、場地日常運作及人流管理等，以及擔任藝術家與觀眾的橋樑，向參觀人士介紹展覽內容和展品，並協助進行宣傳推廣活動。
english: The interns will support the preparation and daily operations, as well as venue and crowd management, for the Hong Kong Exhibition at the Venice Biennale. They will also serve as a bridge between artists and audiences, introducing the exhibition to visitors and assisting with the promotion and publicity campaigns.

chinese: 實習生將協助香港展的籌備、場地日常運作及人流管理等，以及擔任藝術家與觀眾的橋樑，向參觀人士介紹展覽內容和展品，並協助進行宣傳推廣活動。
english: The interns will not take part in the preparation and daily operations, or venue and crowd management, for the Hong Kong Exhibition at the Venice Biennale. They will also serve as a bridge between artists and audiences, introducing the exhibition to visitors and assisting with the promotion and publicity campaigns.

chinese: 申請條件及詳情請瀏覽連結hk.art.museum/tc/web/ma/VB-Internship.html。
english: For application requirements and further details, please visit the link hk.art.museum/en/web/ma/VB-Internship.html.

chinese: 政府今日（十二月十日）開始公開招募青年參與第九期青年委員自薦計劃（自薦計劃），申請截止日期為二○二六年一月八日。
english: The Government today (December 10) started recruitment under the Member Self-recommendation Scheme for Youth (MSSY) Phase 9. The application period will close on January 8, 2026.

chinese: 政府今日（十二月十日）開始公開招募青年參與第九期青年委員自薦計劃（自薦計劃），申請截止日期為二○二六年一月八日。
english: The Government today (December 10) started recruitment under the Member Self-recommendation Scheme for Youth (MSSY) Phase 9. The application period will close on January 18, 2026.

chinese: 獲委任的委員名單已上載於民青局網頁。
english: The list of appointees has been uploaded to the website of the HYAB.

chinese: 發言人續說 : 「第九期計劃參與委員會的數目為28個，涵蓋多個不同政策範疇。我們鼓勵於二○二六年一月八日（即申請截止日期）年齡介乎18至35歲，並有志服務社會的青年，申請第九期自薦計劃。」
english: "There are 28 participating committees in Phase 9, covering a wider spectrum of policy areas. We encourage young people aged between 18 and 35 on January 8, 2026, i.e. the date of the application deadline, and with a commitment to serving the community to apply for the MSSY Phase 9," the spokesman continued.

chinese: 發言人續說 : 「第九期計劃參與委員會的數目為28個，涵蓋多個不同政策範疇。我們鼓勵於二○二六年一月八日（即申請截止日期）年齡介乎18至35歲，並有志服務社會的青年，申請第九期自薦計劃。」
english: "There are 28 participating committees in Phase 9, covering a wider spectrum of policy areas. We encourage young people aged between 18 and 25 on January 8, 2026, i.e. the date of the application deadline, and with a commitment to serving the community to apply for the MSSY Phase 9," the spokesman continued.

chinese: 一般來説，每個參與委員會提供兩個委任名額。
english: In general, each participating committee will offer two seats for appointment.

chinese: 一般來説，每個參與委員會提供兩個委任名額。
english: In general, each participating committee will offer three seats for appointment.

chinese: 視乎實際申請數目及評審進度，招募評審工作預計於二○二六年第三季完成。
english: Subject to the actual number of applications received and assessment progress, assessment is expected to be completed around the third quarter of 2026.

chinese: 視乎實際申請數目及評審進度，招募評審工作預計於二○二六年第三季完成。
english: Subject to the actual number of applications received and assessment progress, assessment is expected to be completed around the first quarter of 2026.

chinese: 填寫申請表時，申請人須以文字（不多於600字）或影片／錄音（不長於三分鐘），以中文或英文闡述自己為何適合獲委任為所選委員會的委員。
english: When completing the application form, applicants are required to write no more than 600 words or provide a video or audio clip of no longer than three minutes to account for, in either Chinese or English, their suitability for being appointed as a member of the selected committee(s).

chinese: 填寫申請表時，申請人須以文字（不多於600字）或影片／錄音（不長於三分鐘），以中文或英文闡述自己為何適合獲委任為所選委員會的委員。
english: When completing the application form, applicants are required to write at least 600 words or provide a video or audio clip of at least three minutes to account for, in either Chinese or English, their suitability for being appointed as a member of the selected committee(s).

chinese: 申請表可透過網上申請系統、郵寄或親身送遞的方式遞交。
english: Applications may be submitted through the online application system, by post or by hand.

chinese: 申請表可透過網上申請系統、郵寄或親身送遞的方式遞交。
english: Applications may only be submitted through the online application system.

chinese: 由康樂及文化事務署（康文署）舉辦的「工商機構運動會2025」於二○二四年十二月十二日起接受報名，截止日期為二○二五年一月九日。
english: The Corporate Games 2025, organised by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department (LCSD), will be open for enrolment from December 12, 2024, to January 9, 2025.

chinese: 由康樂及文化事務署（康文署）舉辦的「工商機構運動會2025」於二○二四年十二月十二日起接受報名，截止日期為二○二五年一月九日。
english: The Corporate Games 2025, organised by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department (LCSD), will be open for enrolment from December 12, 2024, to January 19, 2025.

chinese: 歡迎各工商機構和公營機構員工參加。
english: Employees of commercial and industrial organisations and the public sector are welcome to take part in the Games.

chinese: 歡迎各工商機構和公營機構員工參加。
english: Employees of the public sector are not eligible to take part in the Games.

chinese: 運動會將於明年三月至九月期間在全港多個康樂場地舉行，設有十一個比賽項目，分別為田徑、羽毛球、籃球、長跑、五人足球、桌球、乒乓球、網球、保齡球、排球和十一人足球。
english: The Corporate Games 2025 will be held between March and September next year at various recreation and sports venues in Hong Kong. It comprises 11 competition events, namely athletics, badminton, basketball, distance run, futsal, snooker, table tennis, tennis, tenpin bowling, volleyball and 11-a-side soccer.

chinese: 運動會將於明年三月至九月期間在全港多個康樂場地舉行，設有十一個比賽項目，分別為田徑、羽毛球、籃球、長跑、五人足球、桌球、乒乓球、網球、保齡球、排球和十一人足球。
english: The Corporate Games 2025 will be held between May and September next year at various recreation and sports venues in Hong Kong. It comprises 11 competition events, namely athletics, badminton, basketball, distance run, futsal, snooker, table tennis, tennis, tenpin bowling, volleyball and 11-a-side soccer.

chinese: 各比賽項目分成甲及乙兩個組別進行。
english: All events will be divided into two groups, namely Group A and Group B.

chinese: 甲組為在香港僱用300名或以上員工的機構及政府部門；乙組為在香港僱用300名以下員工的機構及政府部門。
english: Group A will cover organisations and Government departments with 300 or more employees in Hong Kong; while Group B will cover organisations and Government departments with less than 300 employees in Hong Kong.

chinese: 甲組為在香港僱用300名或以上員工的機構及政府部門；乙組為在香港僱用300名以下員工的機構及政府部門。
english: Group A will cover organisations and Government departments with less than 300 employees in Hong Kong; while Group B will cover organisations and Government departments with 300 or more employees in Hong Kong.

english: For details, please visit the LCSD dedicated website or call 2601 7673.

chinese: 有關活動詳情，可瀏覽康文署專題網頁或致電2601 7673查詢。
